Name: TapeTech Power Assist® MaxxBox® Finishing Box - 10"
Description:
Introducing the new Power Assist MAXXBOX finishing boxes from TapeTech . Now you can have the extra capacity you want with half the effort required from other high capacity finishing boxes. Featuring the same smart design that matches the usable capacity to the application, the Power Assist MAXXBOX is sure to become the industry standard for finishing! These boxes work with all TapeTech finishing handles, including the 8000TT-PA Wizard handle for Power Assist boxes. EasyRoll wheels provide a shoulder to guide the finishing box along the corner bead without after-market attachments or damage to the axle. The shoulder of the EasyRoll wheels is more than three times wider than after-market products, making it easier to place, and keep, the finishing box on the corner bead. And EasyRoll wheels are engineered and designed to be perfectly aligned with the finishing blade, eliminating the need to tilt the finishing box like you must with common after-market wheel systems. EasyRoll wheels do not affect how the finishing box runs on standard flat joints. All TapeTech finishing boxes now feature EasyRoll wheels for finishing outside corner bead.

  • Finishes butt joints and flat joints on walls and ceilings

Features

  • High-Capacity Reservoir: Holds a substantial amount of mud to minimize refills, keeping you on the wall longer and increasing overall daily production.
  • Ergonomic Design: Reduces the strain on your back and shoulders compared to traditional corner boxes, making it easier to handle long shifts and high ceilings.
  • Easy Maintenance: Built with high-quality seals and accessible components that simplify the cleaning process and ensure long-term reliability.

Available Models

  • Standard (14TT): The essential high-capacity applicator for daily production, providing reliable flow and excellent balance for standard corner finishing tasks.
  • Pro (MR01TT): An upgraded version featuring a 20% stronger piston mechanism and enhanced seal longevity, specifically engineered for high-volume professional operations.
